note: Values transcribed from published, lab-analysed food composition tables. Nutrient values are facts; each row cites the table it came from. See SPEC 7.1b.

lebanon-fct.title: Lebanon Food Composition Data: Traditional Dishes, Arabic Sweets and Market Foods
lebanon-fct.publisher: Lebanese University, Faculty of Public Health, with WHO EMRO
lebanon-fct.method: Laboratory analysis of 150 samples across five Lebanese governorates, 30 dishes, per 100 g of edible portion.

sfct.title: Saudi Food Composition Tables
sfct.publisher: Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), National Nutrition Committee
sfct.method: Each dish prepared in three replicates by three chefs to a documented recipe; at least twelve samples per dish analysed in ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratories, per 100 g of edible portion.
